verdict: Airtable: Choose Airtable when you need a flexible database/app layer for operational trackers — landscape beside Work OS and Notion. Scores use the project-management editorial methodology from first-party research as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing.
tradeoffs: Seat minimums and AI credit bundles vs published per-seat floors
Work OS breadth vs specialist timeline / PDF / remote / desktop depth
Automation and reporting depth vs ease of use for small teams
Included AI credits vs paid AI add-ons or credit top-ups
recommendation: Choose Airtable when you need a flexible database/app layer for operational trackers — landscape beside Work OS and Notion. Compare Notion for docs-first, Smartsheet for PMO grids, and Asana/monday for dedicated Work OS execution.
editorialNotes: Project-management Priority-2 batch. Approved on project-management-editorial v1.0.0. membershipRole=primary. jobCluster=docs-db-hybrid. handsOnTesting=false. Affiliate economics excluded.

criterionAssessments.rationale: Familiar sheet UX with database power — learning curve rises with Interfaces/automations.
Can model projects well, but not a dedicated Work OS planning product.
Automations are capable; still a builder tool more than a PM suite.
Shared bases and Interfaces support team workflows well.
Sync and connector ecosystem is a strength for ops stacks.
Interfaces and views support operational reporting mid-pack.
Scales into Business/Enterprise for larger data apps.
Team ~$20 and Business ~$45 are premium vs Notion/Asana for light PM. Affiliate economics excluded.
AI features present; not the primary wedge vs Motion/Notion AI for many buyers.

overallScoreRationale: Weighted average of the nine project-management editorial criteria using the category weights (work planning 15, automation & workflows 14, ease of use 12, collaboration 12, integrations 12, reporting 10, value 10, scalability 9, AI 6), rounded to 1 decimal. Products are scored inside their job cluster — work OS / PM peers, timeline specialists, and adjacent PDF / remote-access / desktop-workspace tools are not forced into one undifferentiated ranking. Not a hands-on lab score, and affiliate economics are excluded.
